_meta.description: The six waste streams. Bulk density turns the estimated volume into tonnes, which drives gate fees, rebates, taxes and CO2e. Contamination definitions are what the vision model and the salesperson grade against.

rows.name: Cardboard & paper

contamination.low: Clean, dry boxes and paper; under 5% other material.
contamination.medium: Some tape, labels, film or damp patches; 5-15% other material.
contamination.high: Wet, food-soiled or mixed with general waste; over 15% other material.

rows.source: US EPA, Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors (April 2016), Paper: Old Corrugated Containers, Flattened = 106 lb/yd³
rows.notes: Converted at 1 lb/yd³ = 0.593276 kg/m³. US survey data, used as a physical property.

rows.name: Clean wood

contamination.low: Untreated, unpainted solid wood and pallets; intact pieces.
contamination.medium: Nails, screws, some chipboard or broken pallets; little else.
contamination.high: Painted, treated, laminated or mixed with other waste.

rows.source: US EPA, Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors (April 2016), C&D: Wood, Pallets and Crates = 169 lb/yd³
rows.notes: Converted at 1 lb/yd³ = 0.593276 kg/m³. US survey data, used as a physical property.

rows.name: Mixed construction waste
rows.examples: rubble, timber, plasterboard, packaging from a site

contamination.low: Mostly inert (concrete, brick, tile) with some timber and metal.
contamination.medium: Inert plus plasterboard, plastics, insulation and packaging.
contamination.high: Large share of general waste, insulation or suspect items needing checks.

rows.source: US EPA, Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors (April 2016), C&D: Remainder/Composite, Construction and Demolition = 417 lb/yd³
rows.notes: Converted at 1 lb/yd³ = 0.593276 kg/m³. US survey data, used as a physical property.

rows.name: Scrap metal

contamination.low: Clean, sorted metal; one alloy family.
contamination.medium: Mixed metals with some paint, plastic or wood attached.
contamination.high: Oily swarf, mixed with other waste, or attached non-metal components.

rows.source: US EPA, Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors (April 2016), C&D: Metal, Other Ferrous = 225 lb/yd³
rows.notes: Converted at 1 lb/yd³ = 0.593276 kg/m³. US survey data, used as a physical property.

rows.name: Plastic film
rows.examples: stretch wrap, shrink film, LDPE bags

contamination.low: Clear or natural LDPE film, dry, few labels.
contamination.medium: Coloured or printed film, some tape and labels.
contamination.high: Food or soil residue, mixed plastics, wet.

rows.source: US EPA, Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors (April 2016), Plastic: Film, LDPE, loose = 35 lb/yd³
rows.notes: Converted at 1 lb/yd³ = 0.593276 kg/m³. US survey data, used as a physical property.

rows.name: Organic / food waste
rows.examples: canteen waste, spoiled product, food processing residues

contamination.medium: Some packaging, cutlery or compostable bags mixed in.
contamination.high: Heavily packaged product or mixed with general waste.

rows.source: US EPA, Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors (April 2016), Food: Food Waste = 463 lb/yd³
rows.notes: Converted at 1 lb/yd³ = 0.593276 kg/m³. US survey data, used as a physical property.
